Test Case 8: PR Creation Operation Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Working Directory: /tmp/test-repo-TIMESTAMP (from push test)
- Command: gh pr create --title 'Test PR from POD_NAME' --body 'Automated test PR' --base main --head validation-test-TIMESTAMP

Expected Output:
- https://github.com/metabob-labs/test-repo/pull/N
- OR: a pull request for branch "validation-test-TIMESTAMP" into branch "main" already exists

Expected Output (on failure):
- HTTP 401: Requires authentication
- gh: command not found
- failed to run gh pr create

Validation:
- Output must contain 'https://github.com' (PR URL) OR 'already exists'
- Must NOT contain '401', 'authentication', 'command not found'
- Tests gh CLI authentication and PR creation capability
- This is the CRITICAL test - if this passes, full git workflow is functional
